Name: Chromatic Arrow
Components: V, S, M (a diamond worth at least 50 gp)
Description: You hurl a 4-inch-diameter sphere of energy at a creature that you can see within range. You choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder for the type of orb you create, and then make a ranged spell attack against the target. If the attack hits, the creature takes 3d8 damage of the type you chose.
At Higher Levels:
When you cast this spell at 2nd level or higher, you can choose one of the following effects for each slot level above 1st:
• The spell’s damage increases by 1d8.
• You may choose one additional target within range, and may use a different energy type for each target.
• If a target is resistant or immune to the damage type you deal to them, you become aware of it and can use your reaction to change the damage type to a different one at the last second.
• The spell’s range is increased by 90 feet.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
